verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.unstructured.io/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an explicit 'Agent Instructions' preamble, and a companion agent-guide.md exists that directly instructs AI agents on how to use the product (SDK, API, MCP server), confirming the product ships agent-oriented documentation an AI can be pointed at.
